name: Skills for Paediatric Practice in OT

assessments.name: Child protection module
assessments.description: Students will complete modules online and upload evidence of completion.

assessments.name: School based case study
assessments.description: Students will submit a written school-based case study on one child they are working with in the school context. Students will provide information based on their observations of the child, the child's strengths, areas requiring support and goals.

assessments.name: Skills passport evaluation of practical skills
assessments.description: Students will need to meet the skills outlined on the checklist

assessments.name: School intervention summary report
assessments.description: Students will submit an intervention summary report with recommendations. The report will be based on a child the student provided intervention to in the school setting.

assessments.name: Activity form in Sonia
assessments.description: Students will log placement related hours online in Sonia.

assessments.name: Home based case study
assessments.description: In this written report based on a case-study, students will analyse an assessment, develop goals and select an intervention for fine motor, gross motor or sensory processing skills.
